content.text:
1. **Smallest dashboard screen** — `recovery-screen.ts` (212 lines) in `pi-repo/packages/self-learning/src/dashboard/screens/`; next is `webcache-screen.ts` (235).

2. **Routines endpoint** — served under `GET/POST /api/automations` (+ `/api/automations/<id>/{run,runs,skip,snooze}` and `/api/automations/event-dispatch`) in `server.ts`; there is no `/api/routines` route — the CLI `unown routines` command maps to the automations endpoints.

3. **Six landing benchmark suites** — `edit-bench`, `evalplus`, `livecodebench`, `longhorizon`, `polyglot`, `selfimprove`, defined in the `TRACKS` array at `scripts/landing_benchmarks.mjs:79` and cross-checked in `benchmarks/AGENTS.md` §"The landing-page feed".
